verdict.rationale: Temporal's Worker Versioning lets each Workflow type be declared Pinned or Auto-Upgrade, and it is organized around Worker Deployments and Worker Deployment Versions. The Pinned behavior directly addresses keeping in-flight runs on the code version they started with while new code is deployed, and a community user confirms that determinism is the core constraint versioning must preserve. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence in the pack stating that Pinned runs complete on their original version, no detail on patching or replay-safety tooling for determinism, no hands-on corroboration of the versioning workflow.
